description: This file contains tests for the PresenceManager component within the internal services package. It verifies creation, behavior, expiration, concurrent access, recovery, and eviction logic of presence/leasing functionality used for tracking agent nodes.

classes.name: PresenceManager
classes.description: A component responsible for managing the presence status of agent nodes, including touch/lease renewal, expiration, and recovery from persistence.

methods.name: setupPresenceManagerTest
methods.description: Sets up a PresenceManager instance for testing, including initializing storage and configuration.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_NewPresenceManager
methods.description: Tests creation of a new PresenceManager with explicit configuration.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_NewPresenceManager_Defaults
methods.description: Tests creation of a PresenceManager defaults when no specific configuration is provided.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_Touch
methods.description: Verifies that touching a node creates a lease.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_Touch_UpdateExisting
methods.description: Checks that touching an existing node updates its lease successfully.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_Forget
methods.description: Tests that forgetting a node removes its lease.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_HasLease
methods.description: Verifies the presence of a lease for a node.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_SetExpireCallback
methods.description: Ensures the expiration callback is invoked when a node's lease expires.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_ExpirationDetection
methods.description: Tests that nodes are marked offline after their heartbeat times expire.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_ConcurrentAccess
methods.description: Checks thread-safe concurrent access to the presence manager.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_StartStop
methods.description: Verifies starting and stopping the presence manager works correctly and idempotently.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_HardEviction
methods.description: Ensures that nodes beyond the hard eviction TTL are removed appropriately.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_MultipleNodes
methods.description: Checks handling multiple nodes, including forgetting specific nodes.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_RecoverFromDatabase_NoNodes
methods.description: Tests recovery logic when the database has no nodes.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_RecoverFromDatabase_WithNodes
methods.description: Verifies recovery correctly creates leases for known nodes and marks stale nodes offline.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_RecoverFromDatabase_PreservesHeartbeatTimestamps
methods.description: Ensures that recovery maintains correct LastSeen timestamps.

methods.name: TestPresenceManager_RecoverFromDatabase_SkipsNilNodes
methods.description: Checks that null or invalid nodes in the database are handled gracefully during recovery.
